our_interpretation: In context, enough means enough for reliable reasoning and planning across unfamiliar cases, not merely enough to finish training or improve a benchmark score.
The ordinary reading is that increasing training data alone will not eliminate consequential failures on unfamiliar cases in the configurations under discussion.
Always and never provide no deadline.
Outliers means unusual inputs or combinations, not large internal activation values.
criteria.support_condition: A general result applicable to the specified learning configurations establishes that increasing data alone necessarily leaves consequential generalization failures across the relevant open-ended task scope.
criteria.contradiction_condition: An independently reproduced demonstration establishes broadly reliable generalization to unfamiliar reasoning and planning cases through increased training data alone within the specified configurations.

evidence.explanation: OMEGA finds continuing failures on controlled mathematical generalization tests. Failures in tested models do not establish that every future amount of training data will be insufficient.
The study provides counterweight to a blanket inability-to-generalize interpretation. Its task-specific improvements do not establish broad reliability from data scaling alone.

The study examines transferable representations in obfuscated tasks and reports causal interventions affecting accuracy. Extended thinking and representation interventions do not isolate increased training data as the cause.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: An applicable general impossibility result, or independently reproduced broad reliability on unfamiliar cases obtained through data scaling alone under an agreed interpretation of enough.
